trust_decision.summary: Untrusted entry text (file names, source-command lines) is spliced into an action command string that is run via `<shell> -c`; format_command decides how each entry is quoted, and at the pinned commit it always uses POSIX single-quote escaping whatever shell execute_action then picks.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'External Action Formatting'. format_command's simple-brace branch is the only place where action entries get quoted.

fix_sites.entry_point: TUI keybinding bound to an `actions:<name>` external action (app.rs fork/execute -> execute_action -> format_command)
same external action dispatch; the shell is now resolved before formatting and passed to both format_command and shell_command
new public Shell::quote API (fix.diff:216-246); per-shell quoting for bash/zsh, fish, PowerShell, nu and cmd
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level shell utility module (looks unrelated: completions/integration scripts)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: television/utils/shell.rs:114-121 (Shell::from_env picks the shell from $SHELL when the action sets no `shell`; consumed at television/utils/command.rs:42-43). The fix has to resolve this default before quoting (fix.diff:137-151) and add per-shell quoting in shell.rs (fix.diff:216-246).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The '\'' bash escaping is already correct at the pinned commit and bundled actions pin `shell = "bash"` (cable/unix/git-diff.toml:33), so fish/nu/PowerShell users can look like an unsupported combination.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Simple `{}` must still expand multiple selected entries into separately quoted, space-joined arguments, and file names containing spaces or backslashes must stay literal. Complex `{split:..|map:{prepend:'..}}` templates do their own quoting and must not be double-quoted.

O6_input_shapes: entry containing a backslash before a quote (fish treats \\ and \' as escapes inside single quotes)
entry containing typographic single quotes ‘ ’ ‚ ‛ (PowerShell treats them as quotes)
entry containing a double quote or backslash (nu double-quoted string)
multiple selected entries joined into one command

O7_producer.where: television/utils/shell.rs:114-121 (shell chosen from $SHELL/default when ActionSpec.command.shell is None); ActionSpec shell deserialized from channel TOML, television/utils/shell.rs:26-35

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Complex-brace action templates (`{split:..}`, `{0|..}`) put raw entry text into the action command with no quoting by tv; bundled actions do this, e.g. `opencode -s {split:\t:0}`.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The doc comment says the template handles escaping (television/utils/command.rs:81), so quoting there is the template author's job; it is a template DSL feature, not 'formatting'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function, other branch; bundled examples in cable/unix/opencode-sessions.toml:30

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Preview commands substitute the raw entry into the preview template and run it through shell_command; bundled channels wrap it as '{}', which a single quote in the entry closes.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Previews are a neighbouring feature, not an 'external action'. Quoting there would change the semantics of every bundled preview template that already writes '{}' (cable/unix/downloads.toml:10).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different module (previewer) from utils/command.rs; Template::format raw path at television/channels/prototypes.rs:52; sink at television/previewer/mod.rs:413-418

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a simple-`{}` sugar branch for previews that quotes POSIX-style regardless of the preview's `shell`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer porting the action sugar to previews would copy format_command's quoting, and CommandSpec already carries a `shell` field (television/previewer/mod.rs:417).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: global `application.shell` applied to sources/previews but not to channel actions (actions only cloned at television/config/layers.rs:89), so quoting and execution shells can diverge
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The merge already exists for source and preview commands; a quote-shell computed from a different default than the exec shell is an easy mismatch.

O9_family: CWE-78 OS command injection (shell quoting of untrusted entries into a `sh -c` string)

O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests in television/utils/command.rs:252-373 and television/utils/shell.rs tests module; PTY integration tests in tests/pty/keybindings.rs (external action tests). Non-bash shell tests need fish/nu/pwsh binaries installed.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep the POSIX '\'' replacement in format_command (already present at the pinned commit) and declare it fixed, without making quoting depend on the shell that shell_command actually runs.
